cases.indication: short-term treatment of occasional constipation
cases.reference: EMA/HMPC well-established-use monograph EMEA/HMPC/76307/2006
cases.basis: EMA/HMPC classifies frangula bark under well-established use for occasional constipation, standardised to glucofrangulins.

cases.indication: short-term use in occasional constipation
cases.reference: EMA/HMPC well-established-use monograph on Rhamnus purshianus D.C., cortex
cases.basis: EMA/HMPC grants well-established-use status to cascara bark as a stimulant laxative for occasional constipation.

cases.indication: treatment of habitual constipation and conditions where easy defaecation with soft stools is desirable
cases.reference: EMA/HMPC well-established-use monograph on psyllium seed (Plantago afra et Plantago indica, semen)
cases.basis: EMA/HMPC grants well-established-use status to psyllium seed as a bulk-forming laxative for habitual constipation.

cases.indication: demulcent for irritation of the mouth and throat mucosa with associated dry cough, and temporary loss of appetite
cases.reference: EMA/HMPC traditional-use monograph EMA/HMPC/678891/2013
cases.basis: EMA/HMPC grants only traditional-use status based on long-standing use; clinical trial evidence is described as insufficient.

cases.indication: relief of discomfort and heaviness in the legs related to minor venous circulatory disturbances
cases.reference: EMA/HMPC traditional-use monograph EMA/HMPC/375808/2014
cases.basis: EMA/HMPC grants only traditional-use status for fresh bilberry fruit based on long-standing use, not demonstrated efficacy.

cases.indication: symptomatic relief of uncomplicated acute upper respiratory tract infection (cough, sore throat)
cases.reference: Hu et al. 2017, PLoS One, PMID 28783743
cases.basis: Meta-analysis of 33 RCTs (7,175 patients) found significant improvement in cough and sore throat versus placebo, but reviewers flagged poor trial quality and heterogeneity.

cases.indication: symptomatic relief of non-complicated chronic venous insufficiency (mild oedema, heaviness, tingling in the legs)
cases.reference: Azhdari et al. 2020, Phytother Res, PMID 32314844; EMA/HMPC monograph EMA/HMPC/16635/2009
cases.basis: Systematic review concludes red vine leaf extract is beneficial for CVI symptoms but explicitly calls for further high-quality trials.

cases.indication: migraine prophylaxis
cases.reference: Lipton et al. 2004, Neurology, PMID 15623680; Agosti et al. 2006, Phytomedicine, PMID 16987643
cases.basis: A positive RCT on migraine prevention conflicts with hepatotoxicity concerns from unprocessed pyrrolizidine alkaloids and a systematic review calling the evidence base only moderate/unreliable.

cases.indication: glycemic control in type 2 diabetes mellitus
cases.reference: Umbrella meta-analysis PMID 38016844; Berberis vulgaris/integerrima meta-analysis PMC11525128
cases.basis: Multiple meta-analyses reach favourable but inconsistent conclusions on glycemic endpoints, with very high heterogeneity between pooled trials.

cases.indication: type 2 diabetes / glycemic control
cases.reference: Leach 2007, J Altern Complement Med, PMID 18047444
cases.basis: Systematic review found no controlled clinical trials meeting inclusion criteria; a therapeutic effect could not be substantiated.

cases.indication: chronic stable angina / cardiovascular disease
cases.reference: Kaur et al. 2014, Cardiol Res Pract, PMID 24600529
cases.basis: Systematic review found poorly designed, small trials with no significant pooled effect; evidence explicitly deemed insufficient by the authors.

cases.indication: appetite suppression / weight loss in obesity
cases.reference: Jayawardena et al. 2021, BMC Complement Med Ther, PMID 34758791
cases.basis: Meta-analysis of 7 trials found no significant effect on body weight, BMI, or appetite; authors conclude it is unlikely recommendable.

cases.indication: stable COPD (GOLD stages 2-3) / exercise endurance
cases.reference: Yu et al. 2019, Evid Based Complement Alternat Med, PMID 31073318
cases.basis: Meta-analysis of 15 trials suggested possible benefit, but the authors state no studies were placebo-controlled or high quality, limiting conclusions.

cases.indication: self-treatment of pain / opioid withdrawal symptoms
cases.reference: NIH LiverTox NBK548231 (PMID 31643556)
cases.basis: LiverTox documents clinically apparent hepatotoxicity and states overdose can cause seizures, coma, and death.

cases.indication: traditional remedy (root decoction/poultice use)
cases.reference: Moroccan Poison Control Centre retrospective, PMID 24673087
cases.basis: A 467-case poison-centre retrospective found a 39.2% mortality rate, disproportionately affecting children under 15.

cases.indication: traditional Zulu remedy (tuber decoction)
cases.reference: Watson et al. 1979, S Afr Med J, PMID 441880; Steenkamp et al. 1999, PMID 10557008
cases.basis: Documented fatal hepatorenal toxicity syndrome across dozens of pediatric cases and fatal adult cases.

cases.indication: use as a food supplement / food for special medical purposes in the EU
cases.reference: Commission Implementing Decision C(2021) 3935 final, 4 June 2021
cases.basis: EU Commission decision terminated the novel-food authorisation procedure without adding the extract to the Union list; EFSA had found safety not established.

cases.indication: use as a novel food in the EU
cases.reference: Commission Implementing Decision C(2022) 1843 final, 30 March 2022
cases.basis: EU Commission decision terminated the novel-food authorisation procedure without adding the plant to the Union list.

cases.indication: use as a novel food (dried leaves) in the EU
cases.reference: Commission Implementing Decision C(2021) 8703 final, 6 December 2021
cases.basis: EU Commission decision terminated the novel-food authorisation procedure without adding the plant to the Union list.

cases.indication: use as a novel food (berries) in the EU
cases.reference: Commission Implementing Decision C(2022) 8103 final, 17 November 2022
cases.basis: EU Commission decision terminated the novel-food authorisation procedure without adding the berries to the Union list.
